data.description: The Stand Out Bench gets its name from an unusual frame. At one end the black steel frame rises well above the backrest in an angular loop, while the far end of the seat rests on a single green post. Wooden slats form the seat and back between the two. The uneven shape gives a modern campus, an IT park courtyard or a new residential project a seat that looks designed for the space. The listed colour is Sand Beige, but the photo shows a green leg, so confirm the frame colours you want. It is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range. Size and warranty terms are shared with the quote, together with a layout drawing if you need one.

items.pText: The Stand Out Bench gets its name from an unusual frame. At one end the black steel frame rises well above the backrest in an angular loop, while the far end of the seat rests on a single green post. Wooden slats form the seat and back between the two. The uneven shape gives a modern campus, an IT park courtyard or a new residential project a seat that looks designed for the space. The listed colour is Sand Beige, but the photo shows a green leg, so confirm the frame colours you want. It is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range. Size and warranty terms are shared with the quote, together with a layout drawing if you need one.

With a tall frame at one end and a single post at the other, this bench has to be fixed firmly, either bolted self-standing to a slab or grouted into soil. Check both fixing points and the slat screws at service visits. Children may try to climb the tall end, so place it away from play equipment and walkway corners.
